entries.baseline.mobile.android.core.insecure_pe: Potential attack (conditional): An actor controlling an overprivileged application operation could read or change data reachable under its granted permissions. Prerequisites and uncertainty: The particular permission must be granted on the selected OS and protect a sensitive resource actually accessed through attacker-influenced behavior; a request for a permission alone does not establish unauthorized data access.

A permission declaration or launcher entry alone does not establish a vulnerable operation.
